tasks.description: Formulate the complete Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) model. Define: (i) index set i in Products, (ii) parameters profit_i, machineA_i, machineB_i, labor_i, raw_i, min_i, max_i, and capacity limits CAP_A, CAP_B, CAP_LAB, CAP_RAW, (iii) integer decision variables X_i >= 0. Objective: maximise sum(profit_i * X_i). Constraints: sum(machineA_i * X_i) <= CAP_A, sum(machineB_i * X_i) <= CAP_B, sum(labor_i * X_i) <= CAP_LAB, sum(raw_i * X_i) <= CAP_RAW, and min_i <= X_i <= max_i for all i. import pandas as pd

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load CSV and set Product_ID as string index
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
FILE_PATH = r"C:\Users\simon\AppData\Local\Temp\tmp2yons1dq.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(FILE_PATH)
df["Product_ID"] = df["Product_ID"].astype(str)
df.set_index("Product_ID", inplace=True)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build parameter dictionaries keyed by Product_ID (string)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
PROFIT        = df["Profit_Per_Unit"].to_dict()
MACH_A_REQ    = df["Machine_A_Hours_Req"].to_dict()
MACH_B_REQ    = df["Machine_B_Hours_Req"].to_dict()

MAX_DEMAND    = df["Max_Market_Demand"].to_dict()

# Convenience: ordered list of products
PRODUCTS = list(df.index)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Compute capacity limits at 70% of max-demand total consumption
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# If every product is produced at its Max_Market_Demand, total resource
# consumption per resource is the sum of (requirement * max_demand).
# Capacity = 70% of that total.

total_mach_a = sum(MACH_A_REQ[p] * MAX_DEMAND[p] for p in PRODUCTS)
total_mach_b = sum(MACH_B_REQ[p] * MAX_DEMAND[p] for p in PRODUCTS)
total_labor  = sum(LABOR_REQ[p]  * MAX_DEMAND[p] for p in PRODUCTS)
total_raw    = sum(RAW_REQ[p]    * MAX_DEMAND[p] for p in PRODUCTS)

CAP_A   = 0.70 * total_mach_a
CAP_B   = 0.70 * total_mach_b
CAP_LAB = 0.70 * total_labor
CAP_RAW = 0.70 * total_raw

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. (Optional) quick sanity print
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"CAP_A   = {CAP_A:.2f}")
print(f"CAP_B   = {CAP_B:.2f}")
print(f"CAP_LAB = {CAP_LAB:.2f}")
print(f"CAP_RAW = {CAP_RAW:.2f}")

"""
Product-Mix Production Planning MILP
------------------------------------
Maximises total profit subject to machine, labour, raw-material capacities
and per-product minimum / maximum production requirements.
"""

import pandas as pd
from pulp import (
    LpMaximize,
    LpProblem,
    LpVariable,
    lpSum,
    LpStatus,
    value,
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load CSV
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
FILE_PATH = r"C:\Users\simon\AppData\Local\Temp\tmp2yons1dq.csv"

df = pd.read_csv(FILE_PATH)
df["Product_ID"] = df["Product_ID"].astype(str)
df.set_index("Product_ID", inplace=True)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build parameter dictionaries keyed by Product_ID
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
PRODUCTS     = list(df.index)
PROFIT       = df["Profit_Per_Unit"].to_dict()
MACH_A_REQ   = df["Machine_A_Hours_Req"].to_dict()
MACH_B_REQ   = df["Machine_B_Hours_Req"].to_dict()
LABOR_REQ    = df["Labor_Hours_Req"].to_dict()
RAW_REQ      = df["Raw_Material_Units_Req"].to_dict()
MIN_PROD     = df["Min_Production_Requirement"].to_dict()
MAX_DEMAND   = df["Max_Market_Demand"].to_dict()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Synthesise capacity limits at 70 % of total max-demand consumption
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
total_mach_a = sum(MACH_A_REQ[p] * MAX_DEMAND[p] for p in PRODUCTS)
total_mach_b = sum(MACH_B_REQ[p] * MAX_DEMAND[p] for p in PRODUCTS)
total_labor  = sum(LABOR_REQ[p]  * MAX_DEMAND[p] for p in PRODUCTS)
total_raw    = sum(RAW_REQ[p]    * MAX_DEMAND[p] for p in PRODUCTS)

CAP_A   = 0.70 * total_mach_a
CAP_B   = 0.70 * total_mach_b
CAP_LAB = 0.70 * total_labor
CAP_RAW = 0.70 * total_raw

print("-" * 50)
print("SYNTHESISED CAPACITY LIMITS (70% of max-demand total)")
print("-" * 50)
print(f"Machine A capacity : {CAP_A:>12.2f} hrs")
print(f"Machine B capacity : {CAP_B:>12.2f} hrs")
print(f"Labor capacity     : {CAP_LAB:>12.2f} hrs")
print(f"Raw material cap.  : {CAP_RAW:>12.2f} units")
print("-" * 50)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define MILP model
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
model = LpProblem("Product_Mix_Profit_Maximization", LpMaximize)

# Integer production quantities with individual min / max bounds
X = {
    p: LpVariable(
        name=f"X_{p}",
        lowBound=MIN_PROD[p],
        upBound=MAX_DEMAND[p],
        cat="Integer",
    )
    for p in PRODUCTS
}

# Objective: maximise total profit
model += lpSum([PROFIT[p] * X[p] for p in PRODUCTS]), "Total_Profit"

# Resource constraints
model += lpSum([MACH_A_REQ[p] * X[p] for p in PRODUCTS]) <= CAP_A, "Machine_A_Capacity"
model += lpSum([MACH_B_REQ[p] * X[p] for p in PRODUCTS]) <= CAP_B, "Machine_B_Capacity"
model += lpSum([LABOR_REQ[p]  * X[p] for p in PRODUCTS]) <= CAP_LAB, "Labor_Capacity"
model += lpSum([RAW_REQ[p]    * X[p] for p in PRODUCTS]) <= CAP_RAW, "Raw_Material_Capacity"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Solve
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Report results
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n" + "=" * 50)
print("OPTIMISATION RESULTS")
print("=" * 50)
print(f"Solver status      : {LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total profit ($)   : {value(model.objective):.2f}")
print("-" * 50)
print("Production quantities (units):")
for p in PRODUCTS:
    qty = X[p].varValue
    print(f"  {p}: {qty}")
print("=" * 50)

modelling.complete_formal_model:
SETS
  i ∈ Products = {PROD_001, PROD_002, ..., PROD_050}     (indexed by Product_ID from CSV)

PARAMETERS
  profit_i      = Profit_Per_Unit[i]            ($/unit)
  machineA_i    = Machine_A_Hours_Req[i]        (hours/unit)
  machineB_i    = Machine_B_Hours_Req[i]        (hours/unit)
  labor_i       = Labor_Hours_Req[i]            (hours/unit)
  raw_i         = Raw_Material_Units_Req[i]     (units/unit)
  min_i         = Min_Production_Requirement[i] (units)
  max_i         = Max_Market_Demand[i]          (units)
  CAP_A         = Total Machine A capacity      (hours)
  CAP_B         = Total Machine B capacity      (hours)
  CAP_LAB       = Total labor capacity          (hours)
  CAP_RAW       = Total raw material capacity   (units)

VARIABLES
  X_i ≥ 0, integer    ∀ i ∈ Products

OBJECTIVE
  Maximize  Z = ∑_{i ∈ Products} profit_i · X_i

SUBJECT TO
  (1) Machine A:     ∑_{i ∈ Products} machineA_i · X_i ≤ CAP_A
  (2) Machine B:     ∑_{i ∈ Products} machineB_i · X_i ≤ CAP_B
  (3) Labor:         ∑_{i ∈ Products} labor_i · X_i ≤ CAP_LAB
  (4) Raw Material:  ∑_{i ∈ Products} raw_i · X_i ≤ CAP_RAW
  (5) Bounds:        min_i ≤ X_i ≤ max_i,   ∀ i ∈ Products
modelling.pulp_mapping_notes:
- Create LpVariable.dicts('X', Products, lowBound=0, cat='Integer')
- Objective: lpSum([profit[i] * X[i] for i in Products])
- Constraints: lpSum([machineA[i] * X[i] for i in Products]) <= CAP_A, etc.
- Bound constraints: X[i] >= min[i] and X[i] <= max[i] for each i (or set lowBound=min[i], upBound=max[i] in variable definition)

total_mach_b = sum(MACH_B_REQ[p] * MAX_DEMAND[p] for p in PRODUCTS)
total_labor  = sum(LABOR_REQ[p]  * MAX_DEMAND[p] for p in PRODUCTS)

CAP_A   = 0.70 * total_mach_a
CAP_B   = 0.70 * total_mach_b
CAP_LAB = 0.70 * total_labor
CAP_RAW = 0.70 * total_raw

print(f"CAP_B   = {CAP_B:.2f}")
print(f"CAP_LAB = {CAP_LAB:.2f}")
print(f"CAP_RAW = {CAP_RAW:.2f}")

"""
Product-Mix Production Planning MILP
------------------------------------
Maximises total profit subject to machine, labour, raw-material capacities
and per-product minimum / maximum production requirements.
"""

import pandas as pd
from pulp import (
    LpMaximize,
    LpProblem,
    LpVariable,
    lpSum,
    LpStatus,
    value,
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load CSV
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
FILE_PATH = r"C:\Users\simon\AppData\Local\Temp\tmp2yons1dq.csv"

df = pd.read_csv(FILE_PATH)
df["Product_ID"] = df["Product_ID"].astype(str)
df.set_index("Product_ID", inplace=True)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build parameter dictionaries keyed by Product_ID
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
PRODUCTS     = list(df.index)
PROFIT       = df["Profit_Per_Unit"].to_dict()
MACH_A_REQ   = df["Machine_A_Hours_Req"].to_dict()
MACH_B_REQ   = df["Machine_B_Hours_Req"].to_dict()
LABOR_REQ    = df["Labor_Hours_Req"].to_dict()
RAW_REQ      = df["Raw_Material_Units_Req"].to_dict()
MIN_PROD     = df["Min_Production_Requirement"].to_dict()
MAX_DEMAND   = df["Max_Market_Demand"].to_dict()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Synthesise capacity limits at 70 % of total max-demand consumption
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
total_mach_a = sum(MACH_A_REQ[p] * MAX_DEMAND[p] for p in PRODUCTS)
total_mach_b = sum(MACH_B_REQ[p] * MAX_DEMAND[p] for p in PRODUCTS)
total_labor  = sum(LABOR_REQ[p]  * MAX_DEMAND[p] for p in PRODUCTS)
total_raw    = sum(RAW_REQ[p]    * MAX_DEMAND[p] for p in PRODUCTS)

CAP_A   = 0.70 * total_mach_a
CAP_B   = 0.70 * total_mach_b
CAP_LAB = 0.70 * total_labor
CAP_RAW = 0.70 * total_raw

print("-" * 50)
print("SYNTHESISED CAPACITY LIMITS (70% of max-demand total)")
print("-" * 50)
print(f"Machine A capacity : {CAP_A:>12.2f} hrs")
print(f"Machine B capacity : {CAP_B:>12.2f} hrs")
print(f"Labor capacity     : {CAP_LAB:>12.2f} hrs")
print(f"Raw material cap.  : {CAP_RAW:>12.2f} units")
print("-" * 50)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define MILP model
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
model = LpProblem("Product_Mix_Profit_Maximization", LpMaximize)

# Integer production quantities with individual min / max bounds
X = {
    p: LpVariable(
        name=f"X_{p}",
        lowBound=MIN_PROD[p],
        upBound=MAX_DEMAND[p],
        cat="Integer",
    )
    for p in PRODUCTS
}

# Objective: maximise total profit
model += lpSum([PROFIT[p] * X[p] for p in PRODUCTS]), "Total_Profit"

# Resource constraints
model += lpSum([MACH_A_REQ[p] * X[p] for p in PRODUCTS]) <= CAP_A, "Machine_A_Capacity"
model += lpSum([MACH_B_REQ[p] * X[p] for p in PRODUCTS]) <= CAP_B, "Machine_B_Capacity"
model += lpSum([LABOR_REQ[p]  * X[p] for p in PRODUCTS]) <= CAP_LAB, "Labor_Capacity"
model += lpSum([RAW_REQ[p]    * X[p] for p in PRODUCTS]) <= CAP_RAW, "Raw_Material_Capacity"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Solve
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Report results
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n" + "=" * 50)
print("OPTIMISATION RESULTS")
print("=" * 50)
print(f"Solver status      : {LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total profit ($)   : {value(model.objective):.2f}")
print("-" * 50)
print("Production quantities (units):")
for p in PRODUCTS:
    qty = X[p].varValue
    print(f"  {p}: {qty}")
print("=" * 50)

output_schema.solver_status: string — PuLP status (e.g., Optimal, Infeasible, Unbounded)
output_schema.total_profit: float — maximised total profit across all products
